scope: v1.0.14 kinetics, activation barrier, causal broadening, and low-temperature x finite-current joint theory-code limit

lineage_contract.dqdv_change_scope: v1.0.14 adds a degenerate-span/scalar-input equilibrium guard; the finite-array lag law and grid switch remain.

primary_source_checks.title: The Activated Complex in Chemical Reactions
primary_source_checks.verified_claim: Transition-state theory obtains an absolute molecular reaction rate from the statistical probability of an activated state and its decomposition frequency.
primary_source_checks.audit_effect: The kBT/h prefactor is a molecular transition-state result. Promoting it directly to an electrode-scale phase-fraction relaxation rate requires a coarse-graining derivation.

primary_source_checks.title: Theory of Chemical Kinetics and Charge Transfer based on Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics
primary_source_checks.verified_claim: Reaction rates in concentrated and phase-separating solids depend on local activities, reaction free energy, transition-state activity, gradients, strain, and electrochemical state.
primary_source_checks.audit_effect: It supports local thermodynamically consistent kinetics, not a voltage-independent affinity frozen at an arbitrary peak cut.

primary_source_checks.title: Rate dependency of incremental capacity analysis (dQ/dV) as a diagnostic tool for lithium-ion batteries
primary_source_checks.verified_claim: In commercial NCA/graphite and LFP/graphite full cells, increasing rate lowers, broadens, shifts, and can erase ICA peaks; resistance and diffusion effects motivate low-rate ICA.
primary_source_checks.audit_effect: The user's finite-current target is experimentally supported, but the full-cell experiment does not identify a unique single-exponential electrode transition mechanism.

primary_source_checks.title: The Influence of Testing Conditions on State of Health Estimations of Electric Vehicle Lithium-Ion Batteries Using an Incremental Capacity Analysis
primary_source_checks.verified_claim: For graphite/NMC532 cells, lower temperature or higher charge rate flattens and broadens selected IC peaks and increases polarization; features can merge or vanish.
primary_source_checks.audit_effect: This independently confirms the joint low-temperature and finite-current target, while also showing feature-specific and full-cell behavior beyond a universal one-tail model.

primary_source_checks.title: Thermodynamic and kinetic properties of the Li-graphite system from first-principles calculations
primary_source_checks.verified_claim: The study calculates Li migration barriers and bulk composition-dependent diffusivity in stage-I and stage-II graphite.
primary_source_checks.audit_effect: A bulk migration barrier is not by itself an electrode-scale phase-transition relaxation enthalpy or exchange-current law.

primary_source_checks.title: Lithium Diffusion in Graphitic Carbon
primary_source_checks.verified_claim: Experiment and first-principles analysis show strongly anisotropic Li transport: fast in-plane bulk diffusion and much slower grain-boundary transport.
primary_source_checks.audit_effect: Transport pathways and geometry must be coarse-grained before a measured dQ/dV relaxation time can be assigned to one barrier.

primary_source_checks.title: Modeling of Galvanostatic Charge and Discharge of the Lithium/Polymer/Insertion Cell
primary_source_checks.verified_claim: A galvanostatic insertion-cell forward model couples concentrated-solution transport, solid diffusion, reaction, and active-material utilization under the imposed current.
primary_source_checks.audit_effect: A prescribed voltage-grid convolution can be a reduced observation model, but it is not a closed galvanostatic electrochemical forward model without current balance and terminal-voltage closure.

grid_handoff.cause: endpoint ODE derivative is summed as a rectangle instead of using the exact cell-average state increment

repair_existence_proof.interpretation: A causal relaxation with a separately calibrated mesoscopic rate can reproduce the target qualitatively. This does not validate the v1.0.14 molecular prefactor, frozen affinity, constant voltage transform, or material parameters.

findings.reason: Primary full-cell data support lower, broader, shifted or vanishing peaks at higher rate and lower temperature, but do not identify a unique single-exponential electrode tail.
dξ/dt=k(ξeq-ξ) has the correct causal, area-preserving continuum limit when the equilibrium target and k are well-defined.
The facade accepts C-rate in h^-1 and Ah-like capacity while func_L_q combines I/Q numerically with a seconds-based Eyring prefactor. Lq is 3600 times too large in that path.
The code prescribes a voltage grid and filters equilibrium occupancy on it; it does not solve current balance, transition-current partition, transport, and terminal voltage under imposed current.
Default n=1 always selects A=4RT, so implemented d ln Lq/dV=0. The user's potential-dependent barrier hypothesis is removed from the computation.
Subtracting χΩ from a common activation enthalpy changes the speed but leaves r+/r-=exp(Aideal/RT). It does not recover the regular-solution local chemical affinity.
Persson studies support bulk Li migration and diffusion physics, not the direct assignment of those barriers to electrode-scale phase-fraction relaxation.
kBT/h with a hop barrier omits active area, site density, nucleation population, phase-boundary mobility, particle geometry, diffusion, and porous-electrode transport.
All four default lag lengths remain below the grid switch for the audited rate/temperature range, so 0.1C and 1C single-transition shapes are identical when IR shift is removed.
With the lag branch dormant, lower temperature only narrows the RT/F equilibrium width and raises the peak, opposite the target finite-current trend.
A direct L_V produces the same nonequilibrium curve at I=0 and I>0. It may be a nuisance kernel only if a protocol law forces L_V to zero with current and constrains T.
At the two-grid-step threshold the kinetic branch carries only 0.7707 of an impulse while the equilibrium branch carries one, causing a 22.9% fit-objective jump.
An infinite Lq from a vanishing rate is converted to L_V=0, which returns the equilibrium peak instead of a frozen transition.
The lag is evaluated once at mean T and mean n; Arrhenius kinetics along a varying T(V) path is not implemented.
Sorting/interpolation by voltage discards revisits and protocol chronology. Hysteresis and memory require an explicit monotone-segment contract or time integration.
For constant I and R, Vn=Vapp-sigma*IR shifts a peak but cannot change its width or height.
One curve cannot separate equilibrium width, heterogeneity, charge transfer, diffusion, phase motion, IR, observation smoothing, activation enthalpy, and activation entropy.
The executable AST of func_L_q, _causal_lowpass, func_dH_a_eff, and _resolve_lag_length is unchanged from v1.0.10 to v1.0.14.
A dimensionally consistent causal reduced model with a separately calibrated mesoscopic Arrhenius rate can qualitatively reproduce low-T peak suppression/broadening.
Use one free-energy state definition, local affinity and transition-state law, current conservation, material/host states, transport, and a separate observation operator.

theory_manuscript_physics_only: Define the written lithiation/delithiation reaction and signed current.
Derive equilibrium chemical potentials from one host free energy.
Derive local affinity from electrochemical potentials, composition, phase fraction, stress, and temperature.
Derive forward and reverse rates from one transition-state free energy and verify detailed balance.
Separate charge transfer, solid diffusion, nucleation/phase-boundary motion, porous transport, and ohmic loss by controlled reductions.
Derive the low-current equilibrium limit and the low-temperature x finite-current competition without numerical grid language.
State that measured ICA broadening is a convolution of physical dynamics, heterogeneity, and observation response.
code_conformance_after_theory_freeze: Use seconds, amperes, and coulombs internally; convert Ah and h^-1 once at the API boundary.
Integrate signed state evolution in time or normalized charge while enforcing sum_j I_j plus background equals applied current.
Solve terminal potential or overpotential self-consistently rather than prescribing a voltage convolution as galvanostatic closure.
Evaluate local T, composition, activity, overpotential, and phase state at every integration point.
Represent microscopic diffusion parameters and mesoscopic transformation rates as distinct typed quantities.
Use a continuous, capacity-preserving small-lag discretization and treat k->0 as a frozen-state limit.
Keep direct L_V only in the observation/nuisance layer and force it to zero at zero current.
validation_ladder: Analytic ideal-site and regular-solution equilibrium limits.
I->0, T sweeps, k->0, k->infinity, and grid-convergence tests.
Single-transition synthetic recovery before multi-transition fitting.
Graphite and LCO half-cell multi-temperature, multi-rate, GITT/rest, and impedance constraints.
Full-cell validation only after host current partition and electrode balancing are fixed.
Public-data holdout with peak position, height, FWHM, area, and voltage residual metrics.
